gates.title: Compatibility proof has no runtime side effects
gates.evidence: This report reads archived Windows Runner JSON reports only; it does not contact Docker, Windows Runner, NAS, Admin API, or Cutter API.

gates.title: Windows acceptance report is provided
gates.required_evidence: Provide an archived windows_acceptance or install_latest_and_smoke report.json.

gates.title: Windows acceptance suite passed
gates.required_evidence: Run Windows Runner windows_acceptance and require status=passed.

gates.title: Cutter uses reviewed auth, not local trusted mode
gates.required_evidence: Acceptance report must show auth_mode=reviewed and local_trusted=false.

gates.title: Cutter sees the expected public-library ready count
gates.required_evidence: Cutter runtime/source-library must expose the current ready release count.

gates.title: Public library first page is readable
gates.required_evidence: Cutter source-library first page must return at least one item.

gates.title: Release/search version matches expected value when specified
gates.required_evidence: Set MIXLAB_CUTTER_EXPECTED_RELEASE_VERSION only when a specific staged release version must be enforced.

gates.title: Cutter search returns public-library results
gates.required_evidence: Acceptance report must include a source-search result with returned hits.

gates.title: Cutter source detail includes transcript text and segments
gates.required_evidence: Acceptance report must prove a public-library source detail transcript remains readable.

gates.title: Real cut smoke report is provided
gates.required_evidence: Provide an archived real_cut_smoke report.json for the same staged candidate.

gates.title: Real cut smoke suite passed
gates.required_evidence: Run Windows Runner real_cut_smoke and require status=passed.

gates.title: Real cut produced an output clip
gates.required_evidence: real_cut_smoke must complete run-next and produce an output_file.

gates.title: Real cut completed source resolution and media cut phases
gates.required_evidence: real_cut_smoke phase_timings must include resolve_source and cut_media with status=done.

gates.title: Desktop screenshot smoke is attached when available
gates.evidence: No desktop screenshot report provided; this is optional for protocol compatibility proof.
gates.required_evidence: Optional: provide desktop_ui_screenshot_smoke report.json for UI smoke coverage.

result.summary: Cutter compatibility proof is blocked until required Windows acceptance and real cut evidence is provided and passes.

collection_instructions: Run Windows Runner windows_acceptance after a staged Docker release candidate exists and archive the report.json path.
Run Windows Runner real_cut_smoke against the same Cutter installation and archive the report.json path.
Pass the reports with MIXLAB_CUTTER_WINDOWS_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT and MIXLAB_CUTTER_REAL_CUT_REPORT.
Optionally pass MIXLAB_CUTTER_DESKTOP_SCREENSHOT_REPORT to attach desktop UI smoke evidence.
This proof only reads archived reports; it must not deploy Docker, mutate NAS data, or change Cutter protocols.
